name: פְּרִזִּי
gloss: Perizzite; perhaps dweller in open country
summary: The Perizzites, a people dwelling in the land with the Canaanites in Abram’s day; the definite singular names them collectively. A tie to פְּרָזוֹת “open country” is possible but not shown.

evidence.note: הַכְּנַעֲנִי and הַפְּרִזִּי are paired singular gentilics naming the peoples then dwelling in the land.

note: Moved from the former word entry `pperizziy` (old root key פרז). The verse establishes the ethnic designation. Its historical connection with words for open country remains uncertain, so no root is assigned.
